verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud platform, but the evidence shows no first-party feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside AWS. Bedrock and AgentCore are developer building blocks for constructing AI apps. Cost Explorer dashboards and CLI tab-completion suggestions are not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
